name: The Quiet (the Scar)
summary: The physical wound left by the Sundering: a visible scar of cracked earth and silver mist running northeast to southwest across Aurelith, from the Stone Crown's foothills to the desert's edge. Within it the Glimmer does not answer — and something listens in the silence. See cosmology: the plane called the Quiet.

geography.character: a band of cracked grey earth and low silver mist, from a stone's throw wide at its narrowest to a mile at the weals
geography.course: Stone Crown foothills → down through the Ashlands heart → Ashveil Cross (the only sanctioned crossing) → thinning tail into the northern Burning Sands
geography.edge_behavior: The Quiet's edge wanders. Farms post watchers with bells; when the bells ring soundlessly, everyone walks backward away from it.

crossings.name: The Veiled Gate
crossings.note: The single sanctioned crossing: dawn passage, single file, veils drawn.

lore_notes: The cosmological wound is catalogued in planes (cosmology.json); this entry is where it lies on the land.
Karvess was vitrified by the Rent — the scar's one great tantrum since the Sundering — and glass still weathers off the ruin into the wind.
Ashlands villages 'pay the Quiet in prayer and silence'; the custom predates the Censer and outlasts every law about it.
adventure_hooks: The scar's edge moves three miles overnight near a village that now stands inside it; the Warden of the Cross needs witnesses who can walk in and walk back.
Something is ringing silence-bells along the scar in a pattern; the Rememberers think it is a sentence.
